questions.text: What does the man say about Mark?

options.text: He was in the department office.
He was looking for a place to live.
He was working on his research project.
He had an appointment at church.

questions.explanation: 'searching' = looking for, 'apartment' = a place to live. Opsi lain bunyinya mirip (department, research, appointment) tapi menjebak.
hints: Fokus ke baris kedua. Cari sinonim kata kuncinya, dan hindari opsi yang bunyinya mirip kata di audio.
Kata kunci baris kedua: searching dan apartment.
Jawaban B. 'searching' = looking for, 'apartment' = a place to live. Opsi lain bunyinya mirip (department, research, appointment) tapi menjebak.

script: Why couldn't Mark come with us?
He was searching for a new apartment.
What does the woman say about Mark?

options.text: She is unsure about the hypothesis.
The hippopotamus is behind the fence.
She thinks that the hypothesis can be defended.
She agrees with the man.

questions.explanation: 'So do I' menyatakan setuju dengan pernyataan positif.
hints: Dengarkan ungkapan setuju, ragu/saran, atau terkejut di baris kedua.
'So do I' itu ungkapan apa?
Jawaban D. 'So do I' menyatakan setuju dengan pernyataan positif.

script: I think that the hypothesis is indefensible.

options.text: The exam is not going to be too difficult.
She thinks that it might be hard.
She's positive that it's going to be hard.
She has no idea about the exam.

questions.explanation: Tag question 'isn't it' menandakan ketidakpastian, jadi 'thinks ... might be hard'.
hints: Dengarkan ungkapan setuju, ragu/saran, atau terkejut di baris kedua.
Tag question menandakan yakin atau ragu?
Jawaban B. Tag question 'isn't it' menandakan ketidakpastian, jadi 'thinks ... might be hard'.

script: Do you know anything about the final exam in Physics?
It's going to be rather difficult, isn't it?

options.text: Never typing the paper.
Not working on the paper now.
Finishing the paper today.
Taking time out from the paper now.

questions.explanation: 'Why not do it now?' adalah saran: kerjakan sekarang.
hints: Dengarkan ungkapan setuju, ragu/saran, atau terkejut di baris kedua.
'Why not ...?' itu pertanyaan atau saran?
Jawaban C. 'Why not do it now?' adalah saran: kerjakan sekarang.

script: I'll never have time to type my paper tomorrow.

options.text: Paul would definitely get a Mustang.
Paul would not get a new car.
Paul did not know how to drive.
Paul did not like Mustangs.

questions.explanation: 'he DID get' dengan nada naik menunjukkan kejutan: sebelumnya ia mengira Paul tidak akan membeli mobil baru.
hints: Dengarkan ungkapan setuju, ragu/saran, atau terkejut di baris kedua.
Kata 'did' ditekankan. Apa artinya?
Jawaban B. 'he DID get' dengan nada naik menunjukkan kejutan: sebelumnya ia mengira Paul tidak akan membeli mobil baru.

script: Did you see Paul driving around in his Mustang?
Then, he DID get a new car?

questions.text: What does the woman say about the meeting?

options.text: The director called a meeting.
The director cancelled the meeting.
The director phoned her about the meeting.
The director called the meeting to order.

hints: Idiom tidak bermakna harfiah. Cari makna kiasan, bukan arti kata per kata.
'called off' bukan berarti menelepon.
Jawaban B. 'called off' berarti membatalkan.

script: What time does the meeting start?
Didn't you hear that it was called off by the director?
What does the woman say about the meeting?

questions.text: What does the woman say about Tom?

options.text: He's lighting a candle.
He's holding the candle at the top and the bottom.
He's working as a firefighter.
He's doing too much.

questions.explanation: 'burning the candle at both ends' = melakukan terlalu banyak sampai kelelahan.
hints: Idiom tidak bermakna harfiah. Cari makna kiasan, bukan arti kata per kata.
Ungkapan kiasan: apa maksudnya kalau seseorang kerja dan kuliah penuh?
Jawaban D. 'burning the candle at both ends' = melakukan terlalu banyak sampai kelelahan.

script: Tom is a full-time student and is holding down a full-time job.
He's really burning the candle at both ends.
What does the woman say about Tom?
